answer: We formulate a dynamic opportunity-cost bond mechanism where staking collateral requires a verifiable delay proof that acts as a beacon against identity synthesis, rendering the relic of ephemeral accounts economically irrational. By imposing subgame-perfect slashing matrices that mirror malicious deviations through proportional forfeiture, the expected utility of Sybil multiplication becomes strictly negative. This equilibrium forces rational adversaries to converge on singular participation, ensuring robust decentralization via cryptographic scarcity.
